THE_PARTITION_IS_A_SUBTRACTION_AND_R_38_.claim: measured -- 2.0.0_SA_COO~G at the cut, token census over the re-derived population
THE_PARTITION_IS_A_SUBTRACTION_AND_R_38_.R_38_says: resolve every row whose {system}/{scope}/{cadence} substitution is MEASURED from a declared source, and card the rest.
THE_PARTITION_IS_A_SUBTRACTION_AND_R_38_.so: A CELL THAT PARTITIONED BY THE THREE NAMED TOKENS WOULD BE USING A FORWARD LIST AS ITS DOMAIN -- the exact defect this project has now been corrected for four times, most recently in the round-16 analysis's own complement. THE PARTITION IS A SUBTRACTION: CARDED = POPULATION MINUS RESOLVED, computed from the re-derived population and never from a token list. The six unnamed tokens are not an oversight to fix silently; they land in CARDED with a reason, and the record says so.
THE_PARTITION_IS_A_SUBTRACTION_AND_R_38_.note: counts are TOKEN-INSTANCES and a row may carry more than one; they do not sum to 1303 and are not intended to.

THE_POPULATION_IS_A_MULTISET_AND_THE_KEY.claim: measured -- 2.0.0_SA_COO~G at the cut, and it came out of this checker's OWN SELF-TEST catching a defect I had already written
THE_POPULATION_IS_A_MULTISET_AND_THE_KEY.so: NO FIELD COMBINATION MAKES THE POPULATION A SET -- there are genuine duplicate rows. The ROW INDEX in the census rows[] is its only stable key, and the record carries row_index on every entry.
THE_POPULATION_IS_A_MULTISET_AND_THE_KEY.how_it_was_caught_and_why_that_matters: the first revision of check_en_r18.py keyed the population on the `current` name. Its self-test printed 'population 630' against the 1303 this seat had measured independently minutes earlier, AND THE DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN TWO OF MY OWN READS IS THE ONLY THING THAT CAUGHT IT. A name-keyed arm would have PASSED a record dispositioning 630 of 1303 with its arithmetic closing perfectly.
THE_POPULATION_IS_A_MULTISET_AND_THE_KEY.it_is_the_estate_s_own_collapse_defect_o: 3.0.0_SA_CVO's round-17 L9 recorded keying on BASENAME and getting 13 keys for 14 entries, and re-ran on full paths before concluding. I wrote the same shape into an instrument within the hour. A COLLAPSING KEY DOES NOT ERROR -- IT RETURNS A SMALLER POPULATION AND EVERY DOWNSTREAM NUMBER AGREES WITH IT.

the_cell.claim: held -- this seat's cut on the analysis
the_cell.what_it_does: re-derives the placeholder population from a source it DECLARES, then dispositions EVERY member as RESOLVED or CARDED, and prints resolved + carded == its own re-derived population.
the_cell.RESOLVED: the substitution is MEASURED FROM A DECLARED SOURCE, and the row names that source. A substitution the cell inferred, guessed or pattern-matched is NOT resolved.
the_cell.CARDED: everything else, each carrying an OWNER and a REASON. Carding is a disposition, not a failure -- R-38 asks for it by name.
the_cell.it_repairs_NOTHING_in_the_registry_or_th: round 13's cell recorded no_repair deliberately and this one does not reverse that. Dispositioning the population is the owed half; changing what the estate emits is not this round's.

the_judgment_criterion_quantifies_over_t.claim: held -- the round-8 analysis s.2, the bar-writing rule its own author took against himself
the_judgment_criterion_quantifies_over_t.applied_here: the expensive bucket is obviously CARDED, because that is where a cell could park work it did not do. AC4 therefore names BOTH dispositions and asks whether each is right at the bytes -- a row wrongly marked RESOLVED is worse, because it asserts a measurement that was never taken.
